# The Straits Times

> > Singapore's leading English-language newspaper delivering comprehensive coverage of world affairs, regional developments, business, and local news with a focus on Asia-Pacific perspectives.

The Straits Times provides authoritative journalism on international relations, geopolitical tensions, economic developments, and domestic Singapore affairs. With particular strength in covering Middle East conflicts, US-China relations, ASEAN regional issues, and Singapore's role in global trade and diplomacy.

## Key Topics

- Middle East conflict and Iran tensions
- Strait of Hormuz strategic importance
- Singapore trade and economic policy
- US-China relations
- Oil prices and energy security
- ASEAN and regional affairs
- India's economic development
- United Arab Emirates and Gulf states
- Strategic reserves and supply chains
- Human rights and governance
- International sports and cricket
- Crime and justice in Singapore
- European Union policy
- Japan regional role
